# Subset to just one and get climatology
```{r}
sample.cell <- sample.transect %>% 
  filter(CellNum == 1500) %>% 
  group_by(Day, DepthBin, Longitude, Latitude, Depth) %>% 
  summarise(Temperature = mean(Temperature), 
            Prey = mean(Prey),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(DepthBin = if_else(DepthBin == 1, "surface", "deep")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = DepthBin, values_from = c(Temperature, Prey))

# interpolate values for intermediate days
cols_to_interpolate <- setdiff(names(sample.cell), c("Day"))

df.full <- data.frame(Day = 1:365) %>% 
  left_join(sample.cell, by = "Day")
df.full <- df.full %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(cols_to_interpolate), ~ zoo::na.approx(.x, Day, na.rm = FALSE)))

ggplot(sample.cell, aes(x = Day, y = Temperature_surface)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()
ggplot(df.full, aes(x = Day, y = Temperature_surface)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()

# export
exporttable <- df.full %>% 
  select(Day, T0 = Temperature_surface, Td = Temperature_deep, Prey = Prey_surface)
write.csv(exporttable,
          file = "C:/Users/patri/OneDrive - Université Laval/Laval_Postdoc/COLTRANE/coltrane-master/sample_cell_baffin.csv")
```

# Cluster cells and see if these could be summarized to fewer samples

```{r}
transect4clust <- sample.transect %>% 
  mutate(DepthBin = if_else(DepthBin == 1, "surface", "deep")) %>%
  # get climatology first
  group_by(CellNum, Depth, Day, DepthBin) %>% 
  summarise(Temperature = mean(Temperature),
            Prey = mean(Prey),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # expand all values per day and depth bin
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(Day,DepthBin), 
              values_from = c(Temperature, Prey)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("CellNum") 

# Direct clustering
trans.hc <- hclust(dist( scale(transect4clust)), method = "ward.D2")
plot(pca.hc, labels = FALSE)
trans.clusters <- as.factor(cutree(trans.hc, k = 4))

# Plot trends of each cluster
transect2plot <- transect4clust
transect2plot$cluster <- trans.clusters
transect2plot <- transect2plot %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = Temperature_1_deep:Prey_361_surface) %>%  
  separate(name, into = c("Variable", "Day", "DepthBin"), 
           sep = "_", remove = TRUE)

# Get average and sd across the clusters
cluster2plot <- transect2plot %>% 
  # TODO change depth from bins to actual depth values in meters
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%  # why are there NaNs???
  group_by(cluster, Variable, Day, DepthBin) %>% 
  summarise(value.mean = mean(value),
            value.sd = sd(value),
            depth.mean = mean(Depth),
            depth.sd = sd(Depth),
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(cluster2plot %>% 
         filter(Variable == "Temperature" & 
                  DepthBin == "surface"), 
       aes(x = Day, y = value.mean, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(cluster2plot %>% 
         filter(Variable == "Prey" & 
                  DepthBin == "surface"), 
       aes(x = Day, y = value.mean, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw()
```


```{r}
# scale
transect4clust <- scale(transect4clust)

# PCA
transect.pca <- vegan::rda(transect4clust)
head(round( transect.pca$CA$eig/transect.pca$tot.chi*100, digits = 1),10)
sum(head(round( transect.pca$CA$eig/transect.pca$tot.chi*100, digits = 1),6))


# cluster
axismat <- vegan::scores(transect.pca, choices = c(1:4), display = "sites")
# Hierarchical cluster analysis - exploratory, nonsystematic clustering
pca.hc <- hclust(dist(axismat), method = "ward.D2")
plot(pca.hc, labels = FALSE)
pca.clusters <- as.factor(cutree(pca.hc, k = 4))


p_biplot_pca_points(rdaoutput = transect.pca, 
                    cluster = pca.clusters,
                    axestoplot = c(1,2), rescaleSites = 0.5,
                    alpha = 0.4, scaleCorrelations = FALSE)
```
